snippet.title: Dennis Nikrasch: The Locksmith Who Stole $16 Million From Vegas
snippet.description:
For more than two decades, casinos across Las Vegas were losing millions of dollars—and nobody could figure out how.

The mastermind behind it all wasn't a hacker, a casino executive, or a professional gambler.

He was a locksmith.

This is the incredible true story of Dennis Nikrasch, the man who became Vegas's most feared slot machine thief. From his early days as a locksmith in Chicago to orchestrating one of the largest slot machine cheating operations in history, Nikrasch used intelligence, patience, and technical skill to outsmart some of the most secure casinos in the world.

How did he beat machines designed to be unbeatable? How did he steal an estimated $16 million without robbing a single casino? And why did authorities consider him one of the most dangerous casino cheats ever?

Discover the rise, the heists, the investigation, and the eventual downfall of the man who turned slot machines into his personal ATM.

snippet.title: The Great Depression Explained Like You’re 5
snippet.description:
It's the 1920s. The party's roaring, the stock market is soaring, and everyone from the barber to the shoeshine boy is getting rich. They call it the Roaring Twenties, and people believe the good times will last forever.

But what happens when the music stops?

In this video, we pull back the curtain on the Great Depression, the terrifying economic collapse that wiped out fortunes overnight. We'll explore how reckless speculation, bank failures, and a decade of denial turned the American Dream into a nightmare of hunger and dust.

Discover the chain of events that led to the 1929 stock market crash, the desperate measures of the Hoover administration, and the radical changes of Franklin D. Roosevelt's New Deal.

snippet.title: Protesters, Bystanders Arrested | Caught in the Crackdown (documentary) | FRONTLINE + ProPublica
snippet.description:
FRONTLINE and ProPublica trace the Trump administration’s federal immigration sweeps in major cities across the country — and the violence, protests and arrests stemming from them. 

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

How did the operations by masked and heavily armed federal agents, sometimes backed by the U.S. military, unfold in major cities like Los Angeles, Chicago and Minneapolis? And how did protesters and bystanders who are U.S. citizens get caught up in the crackdown? Those questions are at the center of this documentary collaboration from FRONTLINE and ProPublica. 

The Trump administration said its immigration crackdown was protecting U.S. citizens by targeting criminals and people who had entered the country illegally. “Caught in the Crackdown” traces how what began as immigration enforcement operations also became something different — with the government arresting hundreds of U.S. citizens who were protesting or observing the raids, and routinely portraying those citizens as domestic terrorists or extremists.

But despite the rhetoric, the reality behind those arrests has often been quite different, ProPublica and FRONTLINE found: “When we analyzed more than 300 of these arrests, we found that while there have been successful prosecutions, over and over, cases have been falling apart, contradicted by video evidence and witness testimony,” says correspondent A.C. Thompson.

Video footage and witness testimony also contradicted official accounts of the circumstances surrounding the deaths of two protesters in Minneapolis, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, at the hands of ICE agents. 

It also traces the role of one of the key players in the operations, Border Patrol commander Gregory Bovino, who defended the aggressive tactics and arrests and called them “exemplary.” After Pretti’s killing, Bovino was moved out of his role and has since retired, with the Trump administration saying it “recognized that certain improvements could and should be made” to its immigration enforcement operations.

The producer, writer and director is Gabrielle Schonder. The senior editor is Frank Koughan. The managing editor of FRONTLINE is Andrew Metz. The editor-in-chief and executive producer of FRONTLINE is Raney Aronson-Rath.

snippet.title: The Financial Scandals Banks Don’t Want You to Know About
snippet.description:
In this deep-dive documentary, we uncover how the world’s most powerful banks bent the rules, manipulated the LIBOR rate, and sold toxic financial products disguised as safe investments. Exploring the lies behind global finance, this video exposes the hidden mechanisms of greed, conflict of interest, and deception that shaped modern banking.

Through real stories and expert explanations, you’ll learn how the manipulation of LIBOR — the benchmark interest rate guiding trillions in loans and mortgages — affected millions of ordinary people without them ever knowing. And how banks misled customers into buying 'preferred shares' and complex financial traps disguised as stable, secure options.

This video reveals the fine line between trust and exploitation, the cycle of fines and reforms that rarely change anything, and what you can do to protect yourself from the next financial scandal. Combining storytelling, economics, and psychology, it turns sophisticated financial fraud into a gripping, understandable narrative.

If you’ve ever wondered how the system is rigged and, more importantly, how to avoid being caught in it, this video gives you the tools to see the traps before you step into them. Stay curious, informed, and financially protected.

snippet.title: Inside the Hunt for the World's Most Dangerous Hacker
snippet.description:
For years, one man sat at the center of one of the largest cybercrime operations in history.

Evgeniy Bogachev, the alleged mastermind behind the Zeus and GameOver Zeus malware networks, is accused of helping steal more than $100 million from victims worldwide. His malware infected hundreds of thousands of computers, enabled massive bank fraud, and helped spread the infamous CryptoLocker ransomware.

Despite being placed on the FBI's Cyber Most Wanted list and having a $3 million reward offered for information leading to his arrest, Bogachev remains free.

This documentary explores the rise of Zeus malware, the evolution of GameOver Zeus, the global manhunt that followed, and why one of the world's most wanted cybercriminals has never been brought to justice.

From secret online identities and international investigations to cyber warfare and modern digital crime, this is the extraordinary story of the hacker who built a cybercrime empire.

snippet.title: Peregrine Financial CEO in Iowa Stole Customer Money - 20 Years
snippet.description: Russell Wasendorf Sr. built Peregrine Financial Group from nothing into a respected Iowa commodities trading firm managing billions. But for twenty years, from 1992 to 2012, he systematically stole $215 million from customer accounts, covering his tracks with forged bank statements created using white-out and a photocopier. His simple scheme fooled federal regulators through dozens of audits. When the fraud finally unraveled, Wasendorf attempted suicide, leaving behind a detailed confession. He survived and now serves a 50-year sentence in federal prison. This is the story of how one man's decision to "temporarily borrow" customer money escalated into one of the longest-running frauds in financial history, devastating 24,000 customers and exposing catastrophic regulatory failures.

snippet.title: The $113 Million Museum Heist That Shocked Europe
snippet.description:
The Green Vault Heist is one of the most daring museum robberies in modern history. In the early hours of November 25, 2019, thieves broke into Dresden's famous Green Vault museum and escaped with priceless 18th-century royal jewels worth an estimated €113 million. The shocking heist lasted only a few minutes, yet it stunned the world and triggered one of Germany's largest criminal investigations.

This documentary uncovers the complete story behind the robbery—from the meticulous planning and execution to the massive police investigation that led authorities to members of the notorious Remmo Clan. Discover how the thieves bypassed security, why these treasures were considered priceless, and how many of the stolen jewels were eventually recovered.

Based on verified information from court records, official reports, and historical sources, this documentary separates fact from fiction while exploring one of Europe's most fascinating true crime stories.

snippet.title: Inside Crown Casino's Biggest Cheating Scandal Ever
snippet.description:
In 2013, one of Australia's most powerful casinos became the center of a scandal that stunned the gambling world.

A sophisticated cheating operation allegedly drained more than $32 million from Crown Casino Melbourne, exposing vulnerabilities inside one of the most heavily monitored casinos on Earth. But the shocking baccarat scandal was only part of a much larger story.

Behind the luxury hotels, VIP gambling rooms, and billionaire-backed empire lay a world of high-stakes gamblers, legal battles, addiction controversies, and growing questions about accountability.

This documentary explores the rise of Crown Casino, the infamous $32 million cheating scandal, the landmark court battles surrounding problem gambling, and the events that would eventually place one of Australia's most famous casinos under intense scrutiny.

Was Crown Casino simply the victim of an extraordinary scam, or were deeper problems already beginning to emerge?

snippet.title: Just how ancient is sumo? - Lee Thompson
snippet.description:
Trace the history of sumo, and explore how the sport was designed and modified to reflect ancient Japan’s culture and traditions.

--

Sumo wrestling is known across the world as a beloved form of entertainment, a grand display of strength, and an ode to Japan's ancient past and traditions. But surprisingly, many of these so-called "ancient" traditions were actually recent inventions. So, what were these fabricated practices, and how do they relate to sumo’s true history? Lee Thompson traces the evolution of the sport.

In a highly unusual move - the Department of Justice has opened a criminal investigation into Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell. As America faces a high-stakes standoff over the future of the Federal Reserve, the traditional independence of the nation’s central bank is under direct attack. This video explores the intensifying war between the White House and Fed Chair, over a $2.5 billion headquarters renovation. We break down why many experts believe this probe is a mere pretext intended to bully the Fed into slashing interest rates to rock-bottom levels, potentially putting the long-term stability of the U.S. economy at risk for short-term political gains.

snippet.title: America Trusted Him. He Was Vietnam's Master Spy.
snippet.description:
For more than 20 years, Pham Xuan An lived a life that seemed impossible.

A respected journalist for TIME Magazine, Reuters, and the New York Herald Tribune, he earned the trust of American reporters, military officials, and diplomats during the Vietnam War. But behind the scenes, he was secretly one of the most valuable intelligence agents working for the National Liberation Front and North Vietnam.

How did a man admired by the Western press become one of the most successful spies of the Cold War?

In this documentary, we explore the extraordinary double life of Pham Xuan An—from his education in the United States and rise as a prominent journalist in Saigon, to his covert intelligence operations, his role during the Vietnam War, and the shocking revelation that stunned the world after the fall of Saigon in 1975.

Was he a patriot, a journalist, a spy, or all three?

Featuring verified historical accounts and research, this is the remarkable true story of the man who fooled everyone.

“ASSAULT IN THE RING” tells the story of boxer Luis Resto, 24 years after the scandal that changed his life forever.
Luis Resto achieved every boxer’s dream when he defeated the previously undefeated Billy Collins Jr. in front of a packed Madison Square Garden. But the celebrations following his victory were short-lived, overshadowed by allegations that padding had been removed from his gloves before the fight.

The scandal destroyed Resto’s reputation and led Collins to a tragic end. The film explores new evidence surrounding this ill-fated bout, shedding further light on the actions of Resto, his trainer Panama Lewis, and officials from the athletic commission prior to the match.

snippet.title: What Iran’s top security official said about June 2025 U.S. and Israeli strikes
snippet.description:
Ali Larijani was secretary of the Supreme National Security Council in charge of Iran’s nuclear negotiations at the time that this 2025 interview was conducted. Iran confirmed he was killed in an Israeli airstrike in March 2026.

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

In a wide-ranging conversation in Tehran, Larijani said Iran had pursued every option to resolve the conflict with the U.S. in a peaceful way and warned President Donald Trump against new attacks, saying there was no chance Iran would surrender. It was Larijani’s first interview with foreign media after he was appointed to his role by the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei following the 12-day war with the U.S. and Israel in June 2025.

Larijani was once a member of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, a powerful Iranian paramilitary force, and served as parliament speaker from 2008 to 2020. In the months preceding the U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran in February 2026, Larijani was reportedly in charge of the deadly crackdown on Iranian protesters and tasked with shoring up the Islamic Republic’s existence in case of war.

Larijani spoke through an interpreter with FRONTLINE’s Sebastian Walker on Sept. 22, 2025, for our 2025 documentary, "Strike on Iran: The Nuclear Question." This was Larijani's last on-camera interview with an American news outlet before he was killed. See a more complete description of our process here: https://to.pbs.org/4lVZKzA

This interview is being published as part of FRONTLINE’s Transparency Project, an effort to open up the source material behind our documentaries. Read more about this project here: https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/about-frontlines-transparency-project/
